summary: Afya Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings disclosure rather than a special situation. Reported revenue of R$985.2 million for the third quarter versus R$928.5 million a year earlier, with nine-month revenue of R$3.0 billion; net income was R$171.0 million for the quarter. Total assets stood at R$9.66 billion against R$9.36 billion at year-end 2025. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are stated; no risk-arb angle applies.
